comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Left (32) is 1 only if a comment restates the OP's view in its own words in a more nuanced or steelman form and then refutes it. It explicitly excludes verbatim quotes and generic summaries. Right (84) is 1 if a comment contains a verbatim or near-verbatim quotation of OP title or argument text. Paraphrase does not count and refutation is irrelevant. The two are close to opposites on the quote-versus-paraphrase boundary, and only 32 requires a refutation. Their null rules also differ: 32 gives null only if both title and argument are missing, while 84 gives null if either is missing and no quote was observed.
